user.title: Set up Solar Savings
user.description: Choose the sensors used to calculate cumulative solar savings. Energy sensors should be kWh counters. Price sensors should expose the current import or export price per kWh in your configured currency. The minimum accounting interval is expressed in seconds; use 0 for immediate accounting on every solar update.

error.duplicate_entity: Each selected sensor must be unique.
error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities could not be found.

abort.already_configured: These energy meters are already configured.

init.title: Configure Solar Savings
init.description: Update the sensors used to calculate cumulative solar savings. The minimum accounting interval is expressed in seconds; use 0 for immediate accounting on every solar update.

error.duplicate_entity: Each selected sensor must be unique.
error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities could not be found.

set_value.name: Set stored value
set_value.description: Overwrites the stored cumulative total of a Solar Savings sensor, for example to initialise self-consumption savings or export revenue from a previous system, or to correct accumulated drift.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new cumulative monetary total, in the configured currency.

cannot_set_derived_value.message: {entity_id} is the derived total savings and cannot be set directly. Set the self-consumption savings and export revenue sensors instead.

invalid_value.message: "{value}" is not a valid amount. Provide a finite number in the configured currency.
